entities.name: IP header compression configuration IE
entities.description: Information element for configuring IP header compression parameters.

entities.name: PDU session type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the PDU session type (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6).

entities.name: 5GMM capability IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE capabilities for 5GMM.

entities.name: 5GS network support feature IE
entities.description: Information element indicating network-supported features for 5GS.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept registration.

entities.name: PDU session type is IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6
entities.description: Condition where PDU session type IE value is set to IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6.

entities.name: UE supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates support for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression in 5GMM capability IE.

entities.name: Network supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression
entities.description: Condition where network indicates support for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression in 5GS network support feature IE.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the 5GMM capability IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the 5GS network support feature IE.
Inclusion of IP header compression configuration IE is guarded by PDU session type being IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6.
Inclusion of IP header compression configuration IE is guarded by UE supporting control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression.
Inclusion of IP header compression configuration IE is guarded by network supporting control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and IP header compression.
